subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Are 16 MiB and 30 seconds acceptable compatibility limits for all supported Copilot BYOK request shapes?
rationale: The security hardening is warranted, but neither current repository behavior nor the published Copilot SDK contract establishes these particular limits as safe for existing large-context, tool-result, or image-bearing sessions.

options.title: Validate limits before merge
options.body: Confirm the largest supported SDK request and slow-upload envelope, adjust the constants if needed, and add representative boundary coverage before landing.

options.title: Accept fixed limits
options.body: Land 16 MiB and 30 seconds as an intentional fail-closed policy and accept that unusually large or slow existing BYOK requests may stop working.

recommendation.title: Validate limits before merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the largest supported SDK request and slow-upload envelope, adjust the constants if needed, and add representative boundary coverage before landing.
